scenes.title: Stavanger Square
scenes.description: A photograph titled Stavanger torg 1967, held by the National Library of Norway and in the public domain. The record does not state a photographer.
scenes.explanation: Slotted plastic pallets did not exist in 1967; only wooden pallets were in use then.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS, Brun, Jac via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Restaurant Esplanadikappeli
scenes.description: A restaurant interior photographed in 1989. The record credits the image to Finna and licenses it under CC BY 4.0.
scenes.explanation: The wheeled wire shopping trolley with casters is a mid-20th-century supermarket fixture that did not exist in the 1989 scene's setting.

scenes.title: Aumessas Viaduct and the Railway Line Toward the Bouffiac Tunnel
scenes.description: A photograph by A. Bonnaud, dated 1899, showing the Aumessas stone viaduct and an overall view of the railway line between that structure and the Bouffiac tunnel, in the Gard, France. It relates to the Tournemire–Le Vigan railway of the Compagnie des chemins de fer du Midi and is held by the Ecole nationale des ponts et chaussées.
scenes.explanation: Modern wind turbines did not exist in 1899, so this object cannot belong to the scene's year.

scenes.title: German 280 Cannon Displayed at the Champ de Mars Station
scenes.description: A press photograph by Agence Meurisse, dated 1918, shows a 280 cannon displayed at the gare du Champs de Mars in Paris. The record lists it among material of the Guerre mondiale (1914-1918) and notes the gare Saint Lazare-Champ de Mars.
scenes.explanation: Telescoping selfie sticks with phone mounts did not exist in 1918, so this object could not be present at this wartime display.

scenes.title: Map of Amsterdam
scenes.description: A map of Amsterdam, dated 1658, held by the Gemeente Archief Amsterdam. The photograph of it was taken in 1979 and is licensed CC BY-SA.
scenes.explanation: LED exit signs with the running-man pictogram did not exist in 1979; they became common only in the 1990s.
